test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Six sports persons are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. R is sitting second to the right of M. Only two people are sitting between R and K. V is sitting second to the right of S. N is an immediate neighbour of both K and V. Who is the immediate neighbour of both M and R?
solution:
**Given: **Six sports persons are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) R is sitting second to the right of M. Only two people are sitting between R and K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd7af2a5afa9f929fcc514f2dc91a4d15a80586069d1a0773baab5d9e2c3f4d6.png] 

2). N is an immediate neighbour of both K and V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8829154d64bfa51c1006a8ad47692e0c3348b4b992583b17eb140cba6d8d6ce1.png] 

3) V is sitting second to the right of S

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbbf3b113bb78b766d758449f6c4a8ba0e6f1d2c278a4868ffee0df56ac42ac0.png] 

Thus, the immediate neighbour of both M and R is "S".

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
